summary.intent: Manage a milestone dashboard (GSD manager) to progress phases 28-32 of the cipher-box project, resolving PR reviews, executing phases, and running simplify passes across completed work.
summary.outcome: All 4 active phases (30-33) were discussed, planned, executed, simplified, and submitted as PRs (#385-#388); 20+ PR review threads resolved across phases 29-30; 73 new SDK unit tests added for Phase 31 coverage.

repo: FUSE-T uses SMB backend (not NFS) due to unfixable macOS kernel bug in the NFS path
All FUSE-T callbacks run on a single thread — blocking on IPNS resolution (block_with_timeout) in drain_refresh_completions was causing O(N*10s) Finder disconnects
Channel-based prefetch pattern (PendingContent/content_tx/content_rx/prefetching HashSet) is the established pattern for async work in the FUSE layer — Phase 32 mirrors it exactly
The mutation cooldown (30s) already prevents refresh/mutation races in the FUSE layer
registerFaroTransport uses a mutable array injection pattern to integrate with Phase 28 logger — intentional coupling deferred until logger ships
bin.service.ts is already deprecated with only 2 consumers; SDK equivalents exist (D-09 and D-15 deferred)
pnpm add must be run from the correct package directory — running from monorepo root or wrong dir silently fails to update package.json
Git worktrees can lock branches, preventing checkout in the main repo until the worktree is removed
The check-api-client.sh git diff guard is intentional: it catches staged-but-not-generated scenarios; removing it causes false positives on every DTO change

code.finding: SENSITIVE_KEYS list must include 'email' — initial implementation missed it; also arrays were not scrubbed, depth limit returned raw object instead of placeholder
scrubObject needed array handling: iterate and scrub each element, not skip arrays entirely
Transport context transformation was duplicated between error and warn paths — extracted toStringContext() helper; also context was not scrubbed before forwarding to Faro
@grafana/faro-web-tracing required for ignoreNetworkEvents/ignoreXhrUrls instrumentation privacy config — must be added as explicit dependency, not just imported
open() and read() both had inline poll-wait loops for unresolved FilePointers — extracted poll_filepointer_resolution() helper; post-resolution logic differs enough that only the loop was shared
unenrollIpns() returned void — unenrollBatch() was summing resolved promises (always 0) instead of actual deletion counts; fixed by returning affected row count
ShareKeyCache key type was string instead of ShareKeyType — weak typing; also missing pruneExpired() for proactive cleanup
1206-line hook split into 3 hooks (orchestrator 378 + actions 478 + write ops 378) to meet <400 lines each success criterion

workflow: GSD manager workflow enables parallel phase work: discuss runs inline while plan/execute spawn background agents — practical for running 3 concurrent agents (execute-30, plan-31, discuss-32) simultaneously
Stale worktrees from merged PRs accumulate and must be manually removed — they lock branches and appear as active in the dashboard
ROADMAP.md merge conflicts are common when multiple branches advance phase status; always take origin/main for planning files during merge
Running pnpm add in a monorepo requires being in the specific package directory, not the root — lockfile-only commits without package.json changes indicate the dependency wasn't actually saved
Prettier formatting failures in CI are common after agent-generated code — run pnpm format before pushing
The /simplify skill launches 3 parallel agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) — wait for all 3 before fixing to avoid duplicate work
GraphQL reviewThreads query is the correct way to fetch unresolved PR threads; REST /pulls/:id/comments returns all comments including resolved ones
When cherry-picking planning commits across branches, use specific commit hashes to avoid conflicts with merge commits

friction: pnpm add for @grafana/faro-web-tracing didn't persist to package.json — caused CI build failure discovered only after push; root cause was running from wrong directory
captureConsoleDisabledLevels is not a valid Faro instrumentation config option — had to remove it after typecheck failure
Phase 31 worktree locked the phase-31-structural-decomposition branch — had to remove worktree before switching back, causing a detour through cherry-picking
ROADMAP.md had 3-way merge conflicts in the progress table on every branch merge — required manual resolution each time
Manager dashboard showed Phase 30 as 'Ready to execute' even though execution was already done in a worktree — disk state doesn't reflect worktree work until merged
Phase 31 CI lint failed with 11 prettier errors after agent-generated code — required a separate fix commit
unenrollIpns return type change from void to number required updating multiple test mocks — cascading type change
